item.title: Blood Lactate Clearance as a Predictor of Mortality in Children Undergoing Cardiac Surgery with Cardiopulmonary Bypass
item.description: Background: Pediatric cardiac surgery is still a high-risk procedure, with mortality being a significant concern. Lactate clearance has been demonstrated to enhance outcomes in critically ill adult populations; however, data regarding its significance in the context of pediatric cardiac surgery has been limited, particularly in resource-limited settings like Nepal. item.title: Level of Coping Skills among Psychology and Non-Psychology Students in Colleges of Kathmandu Metropolitan City
item.description: Background: Coping skills play a vital role in managing stress and adversity, influencing psychological well-being, particularly among university students. item.description: Background: Deficits in maternal knowledge and perceptions can lead to suboptimal infant feeding and incomplete immunization, impacting child health. item.description: For the past eleven years, Nepal Health Research Council (NHRC) has been organising an annual event: National Summit of Health and Population Scientists in Nepal. item.title: Nepal’s First Whole Genome Sequencing of the Monkeypox Virus: Imported Cases from Saudi Arabia with Evidences of Secondary Transmission
item.description: Monkeypox (Mpox) is an infection caused by a zoonotic orthopoxvirus that is being reported in non-endemic regions. We present here 4 confirmed and probable cases managed at Sukraraj Tropical and Infectious Disease Hospital, Teku, Kathmandu. Three patients were Nepalese men returning from Saudi Arabia with fever, malaise, and papulopustular rashes.
